question: Shoma eky’okureeberaho eki: Omwegyesa natandika kukora aha kumanyisa enamba kwongyera obureezi bw’okubara omu baana abato. Nk’omurimo gw’okubanza, nayenda abaana abashaija n’abashiki kukubaasa kumanya enamba 1. Ahabw’okumanya kwe ebirikukwata aha mutindo gwabo, naamanya ngu Vicente ni omwana orikukora munonga, orikwega gye arikukoresa omubiri gwe, n’ahabw’ekyo aza kumushaba kwegyerera enamba 1. Aha rundi ruriku, naamanya ngu Martina na Clemente baine obureezi bwingi omu by’okuririmba kandi nibega bwangu kuraba omu ndirimbo, n’ahabw’ekyo aza kubishobekereza omu by’arikuza kukora. Ni muguzo ki gw’omusingi gw’okwegyesa abaana abato ogurikukirayo kworekwa omu kutebeekanisa kw’omwegyesa ogu?
answer_a: Okugumya
answer_b: Obumwe bw'omutaano
answer_c: Omukago
answer_d: Okushamba

question: Ni eni omuhendo gwaha ebimurikira okukura kw'obwomeezi omu bahungu n'abashiki abarikutandika omutendera gw'okuteekateeka batarikukozesa muringo?
answer_a: Okukoresa okuteekateeka kw'akabonero
answer_b: Okushobora kucwamu ebirikukurataho kuruga omu bintu ebirikugambwaho
answer_c: Okukoresa okuteekateeka kw'okuhakanisa
answer_d: Okukora omukutano n'obusingye bw'obutonde bwona kuraba omu mizano y'okugezesereza

question: Teekateekateeka embeera egi: Omwegyesa omuhyaka aine emisiri ebiri y'ebirikisi erimu emiringaaniza, kwonka ogumu aha misiri nigwojoreka nk'ogurikuruha ahabw'okuba ebirikisi nibitangataanisibwe. Omwe aha baana aija aha mwegyesa yaagira ati, 'Muka, ogu omusiri guine ebirikisi bingi okukira ogundi.' Okurikira omugambi gwa J. Piaget, niki ekirikwoleka omulingo gw'okuteekateeka ogurikworekwa omu kyakozire omwana?
answer_a: Okukwata aha kintu kimwe
answer_b: Okutaanisa enzikiriza
answer_c: Okuhindura
answer_d: Kutagaruka

question: Omwana, arikugyenda na ishe omu mbura, areeba omu iguru yaayorekyeza ebicu, naagira ati: 'Ebicu nibihĩĩire, nikyo birikurira.' Okurikira enyegyesa ya Jean Piaget y'okuteekateeka, niki ekirikworeka omuringo gw'okuteekateeka ogurikworekwa omu bigambo by'omwana?
answer_a: Obuhangwa bw'ebintu byoona
answer_b: Okutaanisa enzikiriza
answer_c: Obuhangahanga
answer_d: Emyemerero

question: Shoma ebirikukurataho: Ni bw'omutindo gw'okushamba ogw'okubanza omu bantu. Nibazannya emizaano omuntu omweirikwatanisa eby'okwehanangiriza omubiri omurundi ogwingi. Omutaano ki ogurikukwatanisa n'ekishoboorora eki?
answer_a: Ekyombeka
answer_b: Ky'okubonabona
answer_c: Ekirikukora
answer_d: Omuringaniza

question: Ni buhinguriro ki obukuru obukuzibwa omu baana kurabira omu mizaano erimu entebeekanisa?
answer_a: Okushushaanisa embeera ez'obuhangwa nk'ebishushani
answer_b: Okuteeka omutima omu omukyeendi n'okumaraho enkaiko
answer_c: Okugambisania ebintu ebirikukirizibwa hamu n'oburyo bwo kubihindura
answer_d: Okwegyesa emicwe n'ebikorwa ebyashingirweho omu mbeera z'obuhangwa

question:
Shoma omubaire ogurikukurira:
Patricia, omwegyesa w'abaana abato, atumira abaana bataano kuruga omu kiraasi ye buri sande kwegyemereza omurimo gw'akagulu k'abaana bato.
Nagambira abaana ngu omwebembezi naija kuteekateeka omuzano gw'akagulu kandi ahiga banywani be kukuratira amateeka g'omuzano ogwo oguteekateikirwe.
Kurugiirira aha byiciro bya Erikson eby'okukura kw'embeera z'obuntu, ekirikwoleka omu kumanya okwo okwabaireho nikyo ki?
answer_a: Okugyemesereza n'okugira enshonga y'okwehurira omubi
answer_b: Okugyenga n'okutagyenga
answer_c: Obushoboorozi n'okutaho omutima vs. okwehurira nk'otarikumara
answer_d: Obwesigye omu bwomeezi bw'omuntu kuruga omu kuswazibwa n'okutekaniriza

question: Omuhurikiizi omu bato, abashaija n'abakazi niboora ebishushani n'ekyanga aha kibanja ky'eishomero. Fabián nagambira omwegyesa ngu tinyenda kuboora ahabw'okuba ekyanga ky'omubaara nikyo kishigireho kandi omubaara n'erangi y'abakazi. Omwegyesa naamugambira ngu erangi n'eya buri omwe, tikuri y'abashaija nari abakazi bonka, kandi ashemereire kugezaho kuboora nayo nk'oku ababozi bakora. Omu bukwatane n'emiringo, niki ekicweka eky'okuteekateeka eki omwegyesa atandiiiseho kirikukwasa omwana kukura?
answer_a: Okukunda omuntu omwe nk'oku ari
answer_b: Okwetegyereza omuntu nk'oku ari
answer_c: Obumwe bw'omuntu omuhendo.
answer_d: Omwetarikirwa gw'omuringo gw'okwetwara nk'omushaija nari omukazi

question: Teekateekateeka embeera egi: Omwegyesa omu omuto omu myaka y'abaana abato atebeekateeka omurimo gw'okugambaana n'abaana omu bwire bw'okutunguuka, ogutandika okubabuuza: "Orikwehurira ota ira?" Buli mwana agarukamu reero atoraho kamwe omu bakaada omwegyesa atekateekaniziize, orurikworeka emishomo etari emwe nk'okutangaara, okucweera, okutiina, ekiniga, obusaasi, n'okushemererwa. Ni by'okwega ki ebiri kukuzibwa ebikwata aha kukura kw'omuntu okurikurugamu omu murimo ogurikugambwaho?
answer_a: Kugamba ebi orikumvoora omu mutima
answer_b: Kumanya ebirikumeeza omutima
answer_c: Okuteekateeka ebi orikumanyisa omu bwangu
answer_d: Shuuruura eiziina

question: Ni enki aha bintu ebi orikwija kurora omwana w'eishomero rya kindagateni naabaasa kwefuga eby'okureeba n'enyegyezi ze?
answer_a: Juan Pablo akaba naayeikiriza muno kucweera omuzano gw'omwaka nk'ekiremwa, baitu habwokuba omwana ondi ahabire akatwara omugabo ogwo, nayikiriza kucweera nk'emwe aha mpara.
answer_b: Cristián naagamba aha nshuraniso z'ebyo arikukunda n'abanywani be b'omu क्लास aha mizano n'emizaano ey'omubishoori erikuzanwa aha ishomero.
answer_c: Paloma akagira oburemeezi bwingi omu kuhingura omurimo kandi, omu nteerane y'ekibiina, nashoboorora kandi naraga emiringo ei yakozeseize kukihangura.
answer_d: Rafaela yaajuna n'abaana abarikumwegaita omu kuorongora eby'okusaasaanisa, okubiha abaana abataagira beeka.

question: Okurikugyenda omu nyegyesa ya Kohlberg ey’okukura omu muringo, ni nshuro ki ahansi aha ezirikukurirana n’ekiteekateeko ky’ekicweka kya mbere eky’obuhangwa bw’omuntu obutakatunga?
answer_a: Ekirungi nikwo kukuratira amateeka obwo gari kugasa omuntu ondiijo wenka.
answer_b: Obusingye ni okukuratira amateeka omu muringo oguhikire, kwetantara ebihano.
answer_c: Ekirungi nikuhikiiriza emirimo ei waikiriziise obu abaandi baine kukora omu kibina.
answer_d: Ekirungi n'okutunga n'okutwarira nk'oku abantu abari haihi yaawe barikukwetenga.

question: Orurimi tibarazairwe nabo, nirwegyerezibwa kandi nikyesigamira aha mikago omuntu ataho n'abantu, hamwe n'obugabe, n'obugyenyi oburikubetaho. N'ahabw'ekyo, okusikara tikurikukiraho. Nirukura omu bice, kuruga aha kuzaarwa kuhika aha myaka y'eshomero. Enteekateeka egi y'okukura kw'orurimi nekwatanisa omuhandiiki ki?
answer_a: H. Maturana
answer_b: D. Ausubel
answer_c: L. Vygotsky
answer_d: J. Piaget

question: Okurikugyenda nk’oku J. Piaget yaagambire, emwe aha mpamirizo z’okugamba kw’abaana bato n’okugira ngu abaana nibakoresa amakuru g’ebigambo bingi kukurusha oku birikwetagisa. Omu bintu ebi ebiri ahansi, eki ki ekirikwohereza aha kyakoleberwa?
answer_a: Omwana agamba “ato” aha motoka y’okusaaniriza eshenyi ishe yaamuheire. Yaayorekwa motoka endiijo, agamba “ti ato”.
answer_b: Omwana, yaareeba ekishushani kye na nyina, yaagarukamu nawe: “omukundwa, murungi, ow’ekitiinisa” reero omwana yongyeraho “omukundwa munonga”
answer_c: Omwana agira ati “taata”, yaabaire nareeba ekishushani ky’omushaija orikugira omutwe gw’empuuta omu magazini
answer_d: Omwana naagira "taata" buli obu aheebwa eccupa ye

question: Omu omwegyesa omu ক্লাasi y'omupiira gw'engaro, abeeshuri babiri nibarikangaanira omupiira; omwe naatsindika omundiira kuba atware omupiira, kandi omundiira naagarukamu n'ebitukuto. Omwegyesa naayeta abeeshuri boona kubahurira ekyabaireho, kandi bwamara kubahurira, naakuratira ebiragiro ebirimu: okuhanangirira boona. Omwegyesa akakoresa muringo ki gw'okumaraho empaka?
answer_a: Okutegyereza
answer_b: Okutebeekanisa
answer_c: Okuhakanisa
answer_d: Okurizana omu kwikirizana.

question: Shoma ibara aha: Abaana babiri nibazaana kandi boona nibagamba omu kasumi kamwe, nibagamba ebi barikuteekateeka, nangwa hatariho ogurikugambira ondiijo. Okurikurugiira ahari J. Piaget, kicweka ki ky'okukura kw'obwomeezi eki kirikworekyerwa omu rurimi orurikworekwa omu mbeera egi eri ahaiguru?
answer_a: Eky'emyaka eteriire kukora
answer_b: Eky'obwengye n'omubiri omuheru
answer_c: Emikorwa yoona erikukuratira amateeka
answer_d: Emikorwa erikukozesa ebintu ebirikureebwa

question: Omugurusi nayenda kuha abeshomesa omurimo gw'okubagaruramu abarikukira omu kicweka kya 50% abataire ebiteebiso ebitari birungi omu kashozo. Ni nshangwa ki aha zirikukurira ezirikubaasa kutorana abaana aba?
answer_a: Omuringo ogurikukirayo kugwa omubara
answer_b: Omukenkye
answer_c: Omurungo oguri hagati
answer_d: Omuringo gw'okubaho

question: Shoma omwegyegyesa akora omurimo ogurikwetwa 'omwebembezi w'eizooba', ogurikugizibwa omwana, buri izooba, agabana n'abanywani be ebi arikukunda, ebi arikwetenga, n'emikoro arikukora arikukoresa ebishushani, ebijukizo, eby'okuzanisa, n'ebyafaayo. Omusingi gw'eby'obwegyesa guri omu mbeera egi?
answer_a: Amakuru
answer_b: Omukago
answer_c: Obumo bw'enyima
answer_d: Obuhungiro burungi

question:
Shomaisho ki ky'omwana omuhwezi arikukwata orubumbo na omwana omu itsya omu kibira ky'ebyamashaza. Akwata orubumbo akagaburamu enshushani ibiri ezirikushushana. Obwo areka omwana akareeba, agira ati, "Ebice by'orubumbo nibishushana?" Omwana agira ati, "Ego, nibishushana." Obwo omuhwezi akakwata ekice kimwe akakirengyereza, abuuza ati, "Hati, ni kice ki kirimu orubumbo rwingi?" Omwana agira ati, "Eki nikyo kirimu orubumbo rwingi," areka ekice eki omuhwezi arengyereize.
Ni mugyenzi ki gw'okuteekateeka kw'omwana atakatandika kuteekateeka guri omu mbeera egi?
answer_a: Okumaliriza
answer_b: Okuhindura
answer_c: Okukwata aha kintu kimwe
answer_d: Okureeta omuhendo gw'ebintu

question:
Orurimi nabwo niakamanyiso k’obushoboorozi bw’omuntu okukoresa ebimanyiso. Okukura kwarwo, nikyetenga okukura kw’obwomeezi n’emyekere.
Nigutiizi ki y’okukura y’orurimi ekwataniise n’omutwe ogu?
answer_a: Emyemerre
answer_b: Omwojo okwikiriza ngu ebintu bimwe tubizaarwa nabyo
answer_c: Okuteekateeka
answer_d: Ekiragarakyeemiza

question: Shoma omubazo ogurikukurataho: Omwegyesa w’abaana abato naatebeekanisiza omuzanno gw’okwegyesa ogurikwetwa: “Kubura omu Kibira.” Nikigambwa aha baana abamwe ababurira omu kibira omurimu enyamaishwa, ebifo ebitakatandikirweho, obucweka obwirekwa, n’akabi kangi. Batakatandika omuzanno, baine kwetorana omweizi orikwija kubajuna. Omwegyesa bwanyima naayeta omwana omwe-omwe kushoboorora ahabw’enki barikwikiriza ngu nibo abarikukwata kubajuna, kandi abashabe kugaragaza amaani gaabo n’obureezi bwabo ahabw’omurimo ogwo. Nic’ekirikukwata aha kukura kw’omuntu ekirikukomezibwa omu baana n’ebirikurugamu?
answer_a: Okutegeera ebirooto by'omuntu ondiijo
answer_b: Okukuratira omutindo
answer_c: Okugumisiriza omuhendo gwawe
answer_d: Okukoragana

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesi omuhango omu kikungu ky'abaana abato akareeba ngu Francisco, omwe aha baana abari omu kikungu, akora ebintu atarikuteekateeka kandi arakarirwa omu bwire bw'emirimo ya burijo. Arareetaana nari alarira ku arakuutsya kukora eki abaire naayenda kukora kandi atwara ebintu by'abaana, ekyarugamu okurwana omu bwire bwabo. Omwegyesereza ku aramubuuza ekirikumubaho nari eki arikuhurra, Francisco atunga amaisho, akwata amaboko ge, kandi tagira ky'agamba, agaana kugamba. Embeera egi egumizemu okubaho okumara esande nyinza bukuru kuruga omu kutandika kw'omwaka gw'eshomero. Omwegyesereza acwamu kukoragana nawe kumugumya obushoboorozi bwe obw'okumanya ebi arikuhurra. Omu mirimo ekurikukurataho, niki ekirikukwata gye okutandika omulingo ogu?
answer_a: Gambira Francisco obwo orikworeka ekyererezi ekibi, ngu asobole kukitegyeka.
answer_b: Teekanisa eby'omugani ebi Francisco yaabaire yeyorekiremu ekyoreka oku okwetenga kwe kumutwara kubi.
answer_c: Mugambire abanywani ba Francisco bamuhemu engyenderwaho z’oku kondoola enyehurizi ze.
answer_d: Ha Francisco aharizo orubaho orukumwegyerereza kworeka omuisho ogurikuhikaana n'enyemoozi ei arikukwata.

question: Omuhendo ogurikukurira: Omu kasumi k'okuruhuka aha b'ana bato, José naaza ahari Rocío omwegi mugyenziwe kumushaba kumuzaana, kwonka akagumizamu naazaana wenka. Eky'okuruhuka kihweire, José, anyamwire, atwara emirimo y'omwishiki n'ebipapuro, abita aha itaka, yaabyijagira. Rocío arira yaikiruka yaaza aha mwegyesa kumugambira ekyabaho. Omwegyesa, kucuura oburemeezi, yaaza ahari José, amushaba kureeba omwegi mugyenziwe, amubuuza oku arikuteekateeka ngu Rocío nayehurra na eki araakore kucuura embeera egi. Omwojo naaza ahari Rocío, amugwamu, yaamuhaayo kutorora ebipapuro n'okurongoosa emirimo. Twaba niturora embeera egi, ahabw'enki omuringo ogukozirwe omwegyesa nigubaasa kuhwera kukura obureezi bw'okutuura hamwe omuri José?
answer_a: Ahabw’okuba nigegyesa omwana kuteenga ebirikwenda kukora.
answer_b: Ahabw’okuba nikuhiga okugira embabazi aha bandi
answer_c: Ahabw’okuba nigegyesa omwana kutoorana amateeka g’emitwarize omunda ye.
answer_d: Ahabw'okuba nikireetera omwana kwega kworeka okukunda n'okufaaho abandi

question: Shoma eky'okushoma: Omu bwire bw'okukora emirimo, abaana babiri nibarwanira okukoresa ekishushani: Josefina asindika Marcos kumutwaara omuzano, na Marcos amugarukamu n'okumuteera omugyere. Omwegyesa naija kubahwera, bombi nibarira, nibageza kushoboorora ekyabaho. Omwegyesa abahumuriza reero ahurira buri omwe ekyamubaho. Ekyakurataho, abakunganya hamwe kugamba aha kyabaho naashoboorora ngu bashemereire kuhurikana n'ekitiinisa kandi batarikukoresa amaani kucuura enkaayana. Abagambira kworeka oku barikumara aha bukyezi bw'omwe nabo kandi ababuza oku barikuteekateeka ngu nibabaasa kucuura enkaayana. Josefina naateekateeka ngu bashemereire kwetonda na Marcos naateekateeka ngu bagabane ebice na bateere hamwe ekishushani. Bombi nibarikiriza eby'okugarukamu ebi kandi bagumizamu nibazaana. Ni bumwe aha buringaaniza bw'enkaayana obw'obusingye obu omwegyesa akoresa omu mbeera egi?
answer_a: Okuhakanisa
answer_b: Okutegyereza
answer_c: Kworobiirikya
answer_d: Okutungaana

question: Shoma omubaireki w’abaana abato ari kukora omu kicweka ky’orurimi omu kushoma n’ekarte enu, ei arikuzuuriza hamwe n’abaana omu mutwe gwe. Obureezi ki obw’orurimi oburikukura kuraba omu bikoreso ebikozesibwe omu murimo ogu?
answer_a: Okumanya amakuru g'ebigambo n'emiramu
answer_b: Okumanya eby'amaisho by'endimi
answer_c: Okumanya ebirikukorwa omu bwire oburikwija
answer_d: Okumanya eby'emiramwa n'enteekateeka y'ebigambo

question: Omuhendo gw'okushushana gw'abaana omu bintu ebikuratiraho nigumanyisibwa guta?
answer_a: Omuhendo gw'ebishushani nigwoleka gye emiterere, omukago gw'ebara ry'ekintu n'ebikorwa ebirimu.
answer_b: Omuntu naayoreka omu muringo gw'akacurama, ebintu bikataandika kwongyerwaho, kandi hakabaaho okutaana.
answer_c: Hariho ekishushani ekikuru n'obusaasi nibyo byona ebiri omuhanda gw'ekishushani eki, ebindi bintu nibyerembera okukirikurugaana.
answer_d: Emihembo negyendesereza, nobwengye bw'okushushana niburiyo, kwonka omukago gw'ebara ry'ekintu tigurikukwata.

question:
Shoma omwegyegyesa alikukiriza kwongyera aha kworekereza kw'obuhangwa kuraba omu kukuzamu obureezi bw'abaana abari omu kibiina kye eky'abaana abato.
Omu mirimo ekurikukurira, niki ekirikukirayo kwikirana kukikorera ekigyendererwa kye?
answer_a: Okushushani omuhanda kushushana ebishushani orikureeba ebintu byobutonde ebirikutaana
answer_b: Okuririmba enyimba ez'omutaano hambukiraaho n'okukomera ebintu ebirikukora oruyoogo.
answer_c: Okuzina orukundo rw'omuziki hano no kutegyeka omuringo gw'okugyenda n'omuhuumuro.
answer_d: Kutebeeka ekikomo ky'ebishushani norikukoresa empapura z'emiringo etari emwe, obukuru butari bumwe, n'emitwarize etari emwe

question: Omugyezibwa omuhiga owa kiraasi ya 4, orikukora n'abegi be aha burenganzira bw'abaana, areeta embeera egi: "Anita akakubatwa omutwe munonga obu yagwa kuruga aha kasiringi arikushambaazana na bagenzi be omu kibanja ky'eishomero. Enyima y'akabi ako, Anita akatwarwa bwangu omugyezibwa we aha bureeberezi bw'obutaazi, ahu yaatungire oburemeezi oburikwetagisa." Hanyuma, omugyezibwa nagambira abegi kumanya oburenganzira obu Anita arikukoresa omu mbeera erikugambwaho kandi, okuhereza embeera endiijo ahu oburenganzira obwo bumwe burikwija kwemererwa. Ni kimwe aha by'okurorraho ebi ekirikukwata aha kucweekereza okwega kw'abegi omu murimo ogwaherize kuteekwa omugyezibwa?
answer_a: Nibamannya oburengane bukuru bw'abaana
answer_b: Nibarikira oburengane obu bakoresa omu magara gaabo ga burijo n'eby'okureeberaho ebirikukwata aha nshonga.
answer_c: Nibakora okucwamu ebi barikuteekateeka aha bukuru bw'okukora omubiri n'okurinda oburenganzira bwabo
answer_d: Nibamanya ebi ebireetera okutatiira amateeka g'abaana

question: Omwegyesi w’ebyeshure nashemererwa omurimo ogurikwija kukorerwa abashaija n’abakazi omu kibinja kye, abanaaba nibakyarirwa abana ba gireedi ya mbere kuruga omu ishomero. Ku baraahikye, omwana weena ow’akasomesa araashutama haihi n’omwana wa gireedi ya mbere, kandi nibaija kuhigwa kumenyana kuraba omu kubuurirana. Enyima y’ekyo, nibaija kukora ekishushani hamwe, barugye aheeru omu kibanja kugabana emizaano. Obu baraamare, nibaija kuganira omu kibinja ekikuru aha byo baaba bahikiriize hamwe. Omusingi gw’ebyeshure ki ogurikukuzibwa munonga n’obuhangwa obu bw’okwega?
answer_a: Obumu
answer_b: Omukago
answer_c: Amakuru
answer_d: Obushoboorozi

question: Omwegyesi, omu bwiire bw'okuteeranira hamwe, naayeta abashaija n'abashiki kubahoora ekintu eki baahikiriizeho omu bwiire obuhwaireho. Kuguha eky'okureeberaho ky'omugisha ogwo, n'abagambira ngu naagyenda omu mashomo g'okwegyesa omubiri (yoga) kandi ngu n'amaani maingi yaashoboirwe kukora omuringo gw'entare. Omushiki nagamba ngu yaashoboirwe kuruka n'amaguru goona hamwe, omushaija naagamba ngu yaashoboirwe kutaaha eriisho rimwe. Omu mbeera erikugambwaho, niki ekirikukuzibwa omu biteekateeko by'omuntu ebirikukwata aha kwetegyereza?
answer_a: Okutegeera ebirooto by'omuntu ondiijo
answer_b: Obwesigye
answer_c: Okwetegyereza
answer_d: Okumuhurira ngu ori omwe aha bantu

question: Andrea na Jacinta nibarikwenda omu kashanku k'okubaka, nibarikiriganwa kubaka omunaara muraiha kurusha endiijo n'ebitare. question: Tweshangire aha bushobozi bw’okukura kw’obwomeezi, niki ekirikubaasa kureebwa nk’enjorekyerero aha biteekateeko bya Piaget na Vygotsky?

question: Ni enyegyesere ki aha bigambo ebi erikwohereza omukago murungi hali okukuura kw'omukago n'enyegyesere z'omutima omu bwomeezi bw'omumaisho; okukurikira enyegyesere ya Bowlby?

question: Okurikugyenda omuri Piaget, omugasho gw'okuzana eby'okufaananya kushaani omu kukura kw'obwomeezi bw'omwana niki?

answer_b: Nikwetwaza, kurabira omu kurundarunda ebintu, okukuza okwetegyereza ebintu omu mwanya, enshonga n'ebirikurugamu, hamwe n'okureeba emiterere y'ebintu
answer_c: Nikukwatagira, kurabira omu kwegyerera, okukuza obushoboorozi bw'okutaanura eby'efaananizo n'ebyahabwomeezi, n'okugumya okwetegyereza kwabo.

question: Kurugiirikana n'enyegyesa ya Piaget, omu muringo ogurikukurikira ogu, niki ekirikworeka ngu omwana ari haihi kuhikiiriza ekyanya ky'okumanya n'okukora?

question:

answer_c: Kuhereza ekitiinisa omu kubuurira n'okuheereza kw'abandi

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesi w’abaana abato, okukora aha mugyigirizo ogurikugyenda n’amaisho ogurikugira ngu: “Kukora ebintu omu muringo ogurikwekwataho, okugaziya obwomeezi bwe, kurugiirira aha byo ayenda n’ebi arikukunda”, naashaba omwana omwe na omwe kuterekera hamwe ebintu byoona byabaire bikozirweho bwaba buhendera omu myanya eyateekanisiibwe. Omwegyesi naareeba ngu Matilda naatereka ebintu atarikukuratira ebirango ebiri aha meza, naabiteeka omu myanya etari emwe. Ni muringo ki gw’okukwatanisa oguraahe Matilda eby’okugarukamu ebirikugyenda nibimubuurira kandi bigashe aha kutuura aha mugyigirizo ogurikugyenda n’amaisho ogurateekanisiibwe?
answer_a: "Matilda, akacupa ako kaine emicweka n'ebikaati by'omubaro tikarikugenda aha, orikuteekateeka ngu nikabaasa kugyenda nkahi?"; omwishiki areeba aha birango yaashanga omwanya ogurikukwata.
answer_b: "Matilda, akacupa ako kaine emicwe n'ebaruha z'omubaro nikaza ahari eryo?" Omwegyesa naamwijutsya ngu ashemereire kureeba aha birango kumanya ebi buri kintu kirikugyenda; omwishiki naareeba yaabiteeka omu mwanya ogurikubaasa.
answer_c: Matilda, reeba aha kaarati eri ahansi y'ekibbo eki omazire okuterekamu, neeba neehwana n'ebintu ebi orikutereka? Omwegyesa amworeka ahu ekisiisi kiri; omwishiki natereka ebintu omu mwanya ogwo ogworekwa.
answer_d: Matilda, ngyire nkureeba ngu obitungire omuhanda nkoku nkwendaire, kwonka oshemereire kureeba ki kumanya ahu birikugenda? Omurundi ogurikwija, yetegyereza gye ahu orikubaasa kubitunga orikureeba abanywani baawe abarikukora.

question: Omwegyesi n’agyezaho kwegyesa ekigyendererwa ky’okwega ekirikukurira aha Mbeera z’Obu সোসাইটি n’Obutuurwa: “Kworeka okusiima omu kwegaita n’abahungu n’abashiki, noomanya obutaanwa bw’emitwarize yaabo.” Ni engyenderwaho ki aha zirikukurira aha kwetegyereza ezirikukwata aha kupima oku ekigyendererwa eki kyahikiiriziibwe?

answer_b: Koresa omuko gw'okukora orubriki abaana nibetaba omu kumurikwa kw'ebishushani by'emiryango yaabo
answer_c: Koresa ekyegeranyo ky'okugera obuhendo abahungu n'abashiki abarikukora ebibuuzo n'abantu abari omu itungo
answer_d: Koresa eby’okukoresa omu kwegyesa abana nibeetabamu omu murikaguro gw’ebihangwa by’ensi yoona.

question: Omukoki gw’abaana omuhanda owa siniya gwine abaana ikumi. Boona bagyenda omuhanda ogwo barikugumisiriza kandi nibashemeererwa eby’okugyenda. Baatanire kworeka okukunda okusoomoozebwa nk’okutwara, okuhisha, okuteeka ebintu kimwe aha kindi, n’okugyunga ebintu. N’ahabw’ekyo, omwegyesa arateekanisa kwegyesa ebigyendererwa by’okwega ebi: “Kugezesa ebintu kurabira omu kumara embeera ezirikwooreka, nk’okushika aha bintu, okuhiga obutooni aha by’okurira, okugyaho eby’okuzanisa omu byombo, okucweeka ebintu, n’ebindi” kandi “Kworeka okukunda n’okusemererwa obu barikugyenda omuhanda ogwo omu mbeera za buri izooba n’ez’okuzana”. Twaba nitureeba emitwarize y’omukoki gw’abaana aba, ni muringo ki gw’okwegyesa ogurikwija kureka omwegyesa kwegyesa ebigyendererwa ebi yatondire?
answer_a: Okushamba kw'ebirikuranga: abaana nibashoma, nibakwata kandi nibagatta ebintu, nibashanga ensi omu muringo gwabo.
answer_b: Omugisha gw'okutendeka omubiri: abaana bahikiiriza omurongo gw'ebintu ebihendahenda ebirimu okusoomooza okutaani-taani, kurugiirira aha muringo ogurikugyendererwa.
answer_c: Ekitebe ky'eby'omugisha: abaana bashuuruura bariire omu ntebe omuhendo erimu ebintu bya buri izooba n'ebimwe ebyatooranirwe
answer_d: Okuteera omuhendo gw'ebya'buhangwa: abaana nibazaana, nibegyezamu kandi nibakwatanisa n'ebintu birungi ebirikushushana ebirikutebeekanisibwa omu mwanya.

question:
Omugyezibwa omu, orikwegyesa abaana b'eky'omukaaga omuhanda, ateekateeka kukora aha bintu ebirikukwata aha rurimi n'okugumya obwengye bw'emikono. Kandi, akora ekintu eki: Abaana, nibakuratira orugano, nibeesiga nk'abanyazi b'omu nyanja nibasherura esente ezihisirwe omu ka, ezi baine kuta omu mwanya gw'ekisanduuko ky'obugagga. Omwegyesa areeba ngu Amanda akagumize esente ze omu mufuko, n'ahabw'ekyo omwegyesa amubuuza ahabw'enki atazitire omu kisanduuko ky'obugagga, kandi yaagarukamu ati: "Tindikubaasa kuta esente omukyo ahabw'okuba zigwa."
Ni buha bw'obuhabuzi obu omwegyesa arakuhe Amanda kubaasa kutunga eby'okugarukamu ebirikumuhiga kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa ky'okwega?
answer_a: "Amanda, kwata ebicweka by'entaashe omu nshaho zaawe, reero ndyakuhwereza kubita omunda." Muhwereze okubita omunda. Bwanyima omubuuze: "Orikubaasa kugeza okukora eki wenka?"
answer_b: Amanda, nooyenda kugeza n'akabokisi k'ebicweka akandi? Ndiineho eizo zirimu obucweka obukuru kandi ekyo nikibaasa kuba kyanguhire. Nooyenda kugeza omurundi ogundi? Ndaakuhe obwire obwingi.
answer_c: Amanda, orikwenda obuhwezi? Nooyenda omuntu akworeke oku orikuta omubyoya? Reeba omwegi mugenzi waawe ogwo, nabikora gye, yemerera haihi nawe nukwo orikugyezaho kutoora.
answer_d: "Amanda, oranyoreeka kworeka oku orikukikora? Ahabw'enki orikuteekateeka ngu torikubaasa kuta omusharire omunda? Noobaasa kukikora omuhanda ogundi?" Waamara kuhurikiza eby'arikuzaamu, yoreka oku orikukora n'omusharire kandi mwegyerereze hamwe.

question:

question: Shoma omwe orikukurataho nagwo: Emwe aha biteekerezo bye ebirikukwata aha by’obureezi n’enyegyesa n’omugasho mwingi n’enyegyesa y’okwegyesa okurikukirizibwa (Mediated Learning Experience - MLE), egi erikugambira ngu abantu nibabaasa kuhinduka omu biteekerezo byabo. question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa puro-sukuru kuronda kukora omu miringo etali emwe, omu bwire obutali bumwe obw’omunteera y’obutoosha, n’ekigyendererwa ky’okwegyesa abaana ekirikukurataho: “Kukora n’obwetengyeerwa oburikugyenda nibukura, nibongyera aha miringo yabo y’ebikorwa omu nshonga z’obwetago bwabo n’ebirikubashemeza.” Kutiija kukihikiiriza, naaronda kukuza omuringo gw’okwega ogurikukora kuraba omu kwegaita n’abaana abandi n’abakuru. answer_d: Omu kuzoona y'okuzana, shaba abaana kutebeekaniza eki baraaza kuzana, emirimo ei baraakora, hamu n'ebikozesebwa ebi baraakozesa.

question: Omugyezibwa orikwegyesa abaana abato, omu bwire bw'okuzana, areeba ngu hariho obutabangaanira ahagati ya Simón na Javiera omu kifo ky'okwombeka. Yaaza haihi kwetegyereza ekirikubaho kandi akareeba ngu Simón arakarire munonga ahabw'okuba Javiera yaasheenyire eky'ayombekire kandi Javiera nawe ari kukarara ahabw'okuba Simón yaatwaire ebintu ebi araakozeseze. Nagira ngu arikukozesa omugisha ogu, omwegyesa acwireho kuteeraniriza ekigyendererwa ky'okwega ekirikugyenda aha madaara goona: "Kukoresa amagezi g'obusingye omu kucumura obutabangaanira obwa burijo n'abaana abandi." Nkoreki ey'omwegyesa eyaba eshemereire munonga okuhiga ekigyendererwa ky'okwega eki kirikuteekateekwa?
answer_a: Buzaho kiki ekibaireho, oku baahurire, n'oba ebi baakozire bikaba by'obusingye nari shi okubaasa kuba by'obusingye. Reero, obahame kwikiriza okutebeekanisa ebirikukora n'endagaano z'okumaraho enkaayana.
answer_b: Buzaho kiki ekibaireho, otabaze n'obukuru bw'okugabana n'okumaraho obuteeteerwa kurabira omu kubuganira. Reero obategyeza kuhuumurira, obasabe kweshengyereza hamu n'okukirizana aha nkoresa y'ebintu.
answer_c: Mubagambe ngu emicwe yaabo ekaba etarikukwata. Reero, mubabuze bombi oku baahurira aha by'okugarukamu by'omundiijo kandi mubahame kwihaho obuteeteerwa omu muringo gw'obusingye, kurabira omu kugamba n'okugabana ebi barikuteekateeka.
answer_d: Baza omwe bombi bagambe ekyabaho buri omwe, nibahiga kwetegyereza enshobi eyakozirwe, reero obagambire basabe okusaasira kandi bagumizemu kukora nibagabana ebikoreso.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omuhereza omu by'abana, omu kicweka ky'Obuhanda n'Obutuurwa, ari kukora ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa ekirikugira ngu: "Kushemererwa okuri haihi y'abaana n'abakuru omu mizaano n'embeera za buri izooba." Ni micwe ki y'abaana erikwoleka ngu ekigyendererwa eki kyahikiirirwe?
answer_a: Maximiliano naashutama haihi ya Agustina obu amushaba kumushutama haihi.
answer_b: Valeria naramutsa abanywani be n'abegyezi be ku yaingira omu kika ky'eishomo.
answer_c: Rubén naaza omu ka kandi nagumizamu naaza na Renato
answer_d: Francisca agabira ebintu by'okubaka ebi akoresa na Pedro.

question: Omwegyesi w’abaana abato omuhanda ogw’okutandika, omu nshonga y’obwenegura n’okukwatanisa, naija kukora aha mugasho gw’okwegyesa ogurikukurataho: “Kwetegyereza ngu ebimwe aha bikorwa byabo n’ebicweka byabo ebirikukwata aha kuteza omuhendo emizaano n’emirimo ey’omukago nibireetera abandi kubakurira.” Kucungura eki, naayeta abaana kwetaba omu kumanya okushemeire aha rubaraza, ahu baraatebeekanisiza omu ttiimu kukora emizaano y’okuhiganira. Aha muheru gw’okumanya eki, niki eki omwegyesi yaakukora ekiraahangira omugasho gw’okwegyesa?
answer_a: Amateeka g'omuzano gakaba gari gaha? Eri rikaba riri enzibu kukuratira kukira agandi? Okaba owehura ngu ab'eishemwe bakukwatanisa?
answer_b: Okakiku ota otya okwetaba omu gw'omuzano? Ota otekereza otya aha birugire omu rurembo? Ni biki ebi oraakundire kuhindura omu bwire oburikwija?
answer_c: Okugaba omurimo kwaitu, bicweka ki ewaacwireho kukora omurimo omu bitiina? Hakaba hariho okuteitana kwona okurikukwata ahariimwe? Ku kiraabe nikwo kiri, mukiihuriire muta?
answer_d: Orikukozire ota omu mizaano? Kandi kiki ekyaraabeho waabaire oine kumara ebizibu byoona wenka? Kiki ekyaraabeho omwe ahariimwe yaaba atarikwetaba?

question: Omugyezaho omwegyesa owa kindergateni araagabana n'ekibiina kye orugano rw'emotoka ahabw'okukora aha kiragiro ky'okwegyesa ekirikukurataho kuruga omu mutima gw'Okuteekateeka kw'Eshomo: "Okugyezaho n'ebintu bitari bimwe omu kubaho kw'emikago erikurataana." Kandi, yaatooraine ekiragiro ky'okwegyesa ekirikutaangaanisa kuruga omu mutima gw'Amaani n'Okwehereza: "Okuhikaanisa obuhangwa bwabo bw'omubiri n'obw'omutwe omu kwega amaani n'okutsindika." Ni mugyezaho ki gw'okwegyesa oguraabe gubwire omugasho ahabw'ebigyendererwa byombi?
answer_a: Abaana nibakuratira omugani gwa "Rapunzel." Abantu abarikukuratira omu mugani bagyenda omu mutego gw'emikanda y'amareeba, reero bakahungya omutwe gw'omukazi orikukuruura n'obutaayi, nibagarukamu orutindo oruhango-oruto.
answer_b: Abaana nibakuratira omugani "Enjubaasha Nshaatu," nibetebeekanisiza omu ttiimu ibiri. Nibaija kutwaara ebijanjaazo omu magare kwombeka amaka, nibabitebeekanisa kuruga omu buceene okuhika omu bunene.
answer_c: Abaana nibakuratira omugani "Akakazi Kamucwezi Akatukura." Abantu abarikukuratira omugani nibaija kwiruka omuhanda ogurikumanyisibwa, baitwire ekibbo ekijwiire ebijuma, ebi baraaroonda bwanyima kurugiirira aha bunene n'emiringo yaabyo.
answer_d: Abaana nibakuratira omugani "Goldilocks." Okubanza, nibamaliriza orugyendo rw'eka y'omushaija owa bear omu kibira, nibetantara ebintu ebirikubataagura, kandi ku bahika, nibatebeekanisiza amasahani, obukyeeko, n'entebe kurugiirira aha bunene, kuruga aha kisinga obunene kuhika aha kitari kinene.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa Kindergarten, omu mutwe gw'okucookereza eby'obutonde, ariyo naakora omulimo gw'okuteera omu bbuga omu mutwe gw'okwegyesa ogurikukwata aha mbeera y'omubiri n'okugyeza: "Okukoresa ebika by'omwanya." Noorekire aha mutindo gw'abaana, niki ekirikworeka gye okuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa?
answer_a: Pablo agizire: "Reka tuteeke endeku aha ddirisa."
answer_b: Ignacia nagira: "Twineetaga kuteeba embibo reero tuteeke itaka ahaiguru."
answer_c: Yohaana agira ati: "Furansisika, empango zita omunda y'e ndobo, hatariyo hanze."
answer_d: Fernanda agizire ati: "Reka tuteere ebimera ebi ahagati y'orugo n'omuti."

question: Twihwireire aha kukura kw'orurimi omu baana, niki ekirikushoborora ekyanya ky'okutakahurikire orurimi omu kushushanisibwa n'ekyanya ky'okuhurira orurimi?
answer_a: Ekicweka ky'okubanza omwana atakatandika kugamba kirangwa omu kukoresa ebirimi, ebigambo bimwe, hamu n'ebigambo bicweeka; okuhukana n'ekicweka omwana atandika kugamba, ekirikutanndika n'okukoresa sentensi.
answer_b: Ekicweka ky'okubanza omuntu atakatanziire kugamba kirikumanyisibwa omu kukoresa ebigambo, n'ebicweka by'ebigambo, hamwe n'entebereza ezirikwenda; okuhukana n'ekicweka omuntu atandika kugamba, ekirikwetengesa okukuza okushoma n'okuhandiika.
answer_c: Ekicweka ky’okubanza omwana atakatandika kugamba kirangwa ahabw’okwetegyereza empindahinduka z’orurimi n’okukoresa obubonero oburikumanyisa; okuhukana n’ekicweka omwana yaaba atandika kugamba, ekirangwa ahabw’okukoresa ebigambo by’okubanza.
answer_d: Ekicweka ky'okubanza okw'orurimi kirangwa omu kukoresa ebirimi nk'okubabaata n'okugayaaya; okuhukana n'ekicweka ky'orurimi, omu byo ebi birimi nibitunga amakuru hanyuma bikaba ebigambo by'okubanza.

question: Omu omuriira gw'abaana abarikukura bari omushenyi. Sara atumbaho omushenyi, yongyeraho amabaare aha rubaju, reero yahinguraho ekaari. Obwo agira ati, "Nkozire akasozi kanene munonga kandi omuhanda niguteerera, nk'ogwo omuhanda oguri haihi n'eka yaitu!" Tikirugire aha mutima gw'okwetegyereza embeera y'obushangwa n'eby'obuhangwa, niki aha bintu ebi omwana Sara arikukora eki arikushobora kukora?
answer_a: Manya emiringo y'obwomeezi omuhanda omuhanda omu itungo
answer_b: Shuuruura ebiragiro by'okwerinda n'obutebenkevu
answer_c: Shobora emirimo erikukirayo kukora omu itungo rye
answer_d: Shisha ebintu ebirikushoborora ebiri omu butoosha n'ebyo abantu baahangire.

question: Ekibi y’abeeshuri omuishaazi bagyenda kwegyesereza hamwe buri kwezi okukuratira omugisha ogurikugira ngu: “Akuratira emikora y’abantu abari haihi nabo, naatandika emikora ei omwana weena arikukora n’oku arikukoresa ebintu ebi barikukoresa buri izooba.” Ni muringo ki gw’okushishoza ogurikuba gusaana omu mbeera egi erikugambwaho?
answer_a: Koresa ebyahandiikirwe by'okureeba omu bwire bw'emirimo omu kicweka ky'eka.
answer_b: Koresa orubriiki y'okushomesereza omu mizaano y'obusingye n'ekikoomi ky'eby'okwijwara
answer_c: Koresa orutindo rw'okukoresa omu kubangaanisa ebintu by'enju omu bifo by'okukoreramu
answer_d: Koresa okakiro k'okusiima orikukozesa omwanya ogu, nooba ozaana omuzaano "Eky'oha?" nooba otaahurura ebintu by'omuntu.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa klasse ya kashatu, omu mutwe gw'ebyetenga by'abaana, akatoraine ekicweka eki kuruga omu muko gw'ekicweka *Omuhwara Ataabaire Aine Ibara*, ekyahandiikwa Saúl Schkolnik, kutandika kukorera hamwe n'abegyeshwa be aha byetenga by'okugira eiziina: Hatiho omushaija omwe, hakaba hariho omuhwara ataabaire aine ibara ryona. Tikirikugambwa ngu akaba aine ibara rihikire, nari eririkugumira kuryeta, nari rimwe aha mazina ag'obuhangwa, nari obundi ry'omuriihanga... Ngaaha! Akaba ataine ibara ryona. Ekintu kiri ngu, omuntu ku aine eiziina erya Maria kandi omuntu yamweta: —Maria! Omuntu akora enshura ya Maria kandi agarukamu: —Ninde orikweta? Kwonka, omuntu ku ataine ibara ryona, hati omuntu tarikubaasa kukora enshura y'omuntu... Kandi ebintu nibiza kwangirika kuhitsya omuntu aheerize ataine enshura. Aha bibuuzo ebiri ahansi, niki eki omwegyesa araabe asaasaize kwetegyereza ekyasomwe n'ebyetenga ebi araabe ashomereize omu klasse?
answer_a: Ni nkuru ki aha mbeera y'omwishiki omu mugani ekukwasize omutima muno n'obuhingurizi?
answer_b: Ni enyakashe y'omugani egi orikuteekateeka ngu neehikaana n'oburengaanzi bw'abaana?
answer_c: Orikwo orikubaasa kuba enshonga zirikuba ziriho omwishiki omu mbeera y'omugani ataine eiziina?
answer_d: Omugani ogu noogukiraho guta kugira gube n’enkomerero enungi y’omwishiki omu omugani ogu?

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omu itsaare ry'ahaiguru erya kana akakora okushwijuma kureeba yaaba abegyi be nibaasa kucweekereza ebirikubaho omu by'obufuzi, obuhangwa n'eby'obuganga kurugiirira aha biteekateeko by'abafilisoofa ebirikukwata aha byarabaho. Aha mirimo ekurikukurira, niki ekirikworeka obusinguzi oburikukira obw'ekigyendererwa ky'okwega?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza ebirikubaho omu butoosha bw'omuriiki omu biceera by'eby'obufuzi, obugyenyi n'obuhangwa, n'eby'obuhanga, kurugiirira aha muringo gw'okuteekateeka ogu barikwenda.
answer_b: Nibakora orikwenda, nibahandiika orubazo rwabo aha buzibu bw'embeera z'abantu oburikukiraho oburikukwata aha biro ebi, nibakoresa enyegyesa nari ebiteekateeko by'abafilizoofa ebyaganiirweho omu kiraasi
answer_c: Nibarikiriza enyegyesereza y'obufirosoofi ey'omusingye gw'ekizibu omu bantu b'omuri obu bwire.
answer_d: Nibamanya emisingye y'obufirosoofi erimu omu nshonga ey'omuri obu bwire ei barikwenda, ya sabyasiasa, ya muco, nari y'obuhangwa.

question: Omugurusi w’ekicweka kya kindergarten naayeta abaana omu kibinja kye kwetaba omu kumanyisa okutandika omutwe 'Emibiri yaitu'. Okutandika omurimo, bagyenda omu kisaa kya okuzanira kushaka ekitabo ky’obugagga n’ekigyendererwa ky’okushanga eki omutwe omusya gurikukwataho. Nibatebeekanisibwa omu tubinja tushangwa turikureebererwa omuntu omukuru, baryashanga obujwekyera kubahitsya aha kitabo ky’obugagga, kandi bwabashanga, baryagaruka omu icumba ry’okwegera kuteera hamwe ekiteeko hamwe n’ebicweka ebi bashangire. Misingye ki y’ebyegyesa y’abaana bato erikworekwa omu kumanyisa kw’okwegera oku?
answer_a: Okugamba n'omukago
answer_b: Obumwe n'okukwatana
answer_c: Amakuru n'omurimo
answer_d: Okugumya n'obuhunguzi

question: Ekibi y’abarerwa omu mashomero g’abaana bato nibenda omu bwire bukye kwongyera amaani omu kwegamiraana gye hagati y’eishomero n’amaka, amaka gye gamanye ebiri kubaho omu muringo abaana barikwegyesebwa. Ni engyenderwaho ki ehi ekwiriire kukoresa kugira ngu ekigyendererwa eki kihikiirire?
answer_a: Mureete ab’eka zabo kwija omu by’emwereko n’okworeka ebi projekiti ezaakozirwe abaana, nibayoreka omulingo gw’okwegyesa.
answer_b: Butungura emirundi mingi ab’eka n’ebirikumenta ebirikugamba aha mbeera y’abaana omu by’okwega, oburemeezi, n’obukwaasi bwabo.
answer_c: Tukore ebitaramo ebirikugurukirwa abantu boona, ebirikukwata aha misingi etari emwe n'emwe, kugira ngu twongyere okwetegyereza kw'abantu aha miringo abana bato barikukura.
answer_d: Mube n'enteerane za butoosha n'ab'eka okuhana amakuru agikwatiraine n'omulingo abana batooroora.

question: Eky’omutendera gw’okugarukamu omuhendo ogw’okubanza nikikwatana n’omutendera gw’okumanya eby’omubiri (Sensorimotor Stage) ogwashangwa Jean Piaget. Ni embeera ki erikworeka obukuru bw’okukura kw’obwomeezi oburikukwatana n’omutendera ogu?
answer_a: Omwana naakora ebintu ebirikugarukamu ebirikumushemeza kandi omu kubanza tibarikukorwa ahabw'okugyenda, nk'eky'okuhindura n'okutengyetsa ebigyere obutoosha.
answer_b: Omwana akora ebintu ebirikukorwa atarikuteekateeka kandi ebirikumujira byenyini, nk'eky'okunyunyunta engaro z'omureezi nk'aho araabe ari enyungu, yaaba eri haihi.
answer_c: Omwana naakora ebintu byarukiriza kandi byagendererwa, kandi omu bunaku obwo, naahuurira nari yeyorekera omu myeenyo ebi ebintu biri obu atarikubaasa kubireeba omu mubiri, nk'eky'okureeberaho: kuza kushaka ekihahaata kandi yaayimutsya ebintu byoona ebirikwetagisa kukishanga.
answer_d: Omwana naakora ebintu by’agenderera, naamanya okuhingura ebintu arikukoresa engaro ze n’okubigarura omu mwanya gwabyo ogw’okubanza, nk’eky’okureeberaho: okutaana ebikoomi by’okubaka n’obwo akabigarura nk’oku byabaire biri.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa pulimaari, bwamara kukora okukebera, ateekateeka engyenderwaho z'obwegyesa kusobozesa ekibinja ky'abahungu n'abashiki kushobora kworeka enyegyesereza zaabo n'okumpora. Ni engyenderwaho ki aha zino ezirikukwata aha kigyendererwa ky'omwegyesa?
answer_a: Muteekanise omugani, ohingure abahungu n'abashiki kubanga bateebe ekyerarikiriro ogwo omugani ogubateera.
answer_b: Hamuura abaana abashaija n'abashaijakazi kwijuka n'okushushana embeera ezaabareeteire enyehurira ez'omutaano.
answer_c: Mureke abashaija n'abashiki bakundze omufaato gw'okuhindura eky'obusaasi, mubeihurire baguhindure, babaze eky'obusaasi ekirikwija ahaiguru.
answer_d: Gambira abashaija n'abashiki kutaaha omuzano, nibakiikirira enyehurira ezitari zimwe nk'oku zirukugambwaho omu rwimbo.

question: Omuhwezi w’abaana omuheru omu iklaasi erimu abaana abarikuruga omu maka g’emiringo yoona, naija kushwijuma okwega kw’abaana aha kigyendererwa eki ekikuru eky’Obumwe n’Obwetegyereize: “Kugamba n’okwoleka omu mubiri ebi barikwenda nari enyehurira ezirikushushana (okushemererwa, okutiina, obusaasi, n’ebindi).” Eki nikikakorwa, empapura ezirikwolesa ebi abaana barikukora nibiza kukoresibwa. Aha mirimo ei erikukuraho, niki ekirikwolesa ngu abaana bahikiire aha kigyendererwa ky’okwega eki?
answer_a: Rafael namwesereza naakoma omukono obu nyina aije kumutwaara kuruga omu kashagama.
answer_b: Maria arikushoma omukuru omu magaziini, arikureeba ekishushani ky'omwishiki, yaagira ati: Ntaine kushemererwa
answer_c: Natalia naamutwara ngu Gabriel aseka yaamuha ekigyegyezo yaamugira: Oshemerire!
answer_d: Miguel areeba omu ndiba kandi naazaanisa ekyerorezi naakora engyeso ezitari zimwe omu maisho ge: obusaasi, ekiniga, obutasiima.

question: Ekibi y’abegyesa omu kika ky’abaana abato nibateekaniza ebikorwa ebirikwija kubaho omu bwire bw’okuhindura abaana empenda, ahabw’okugyendera aha miringo y’abaana ey’okwetaba omu bwire obwo, hamwe n’amaani gaabo g’okukwata omubiri. Eki nikija kubaasa abegyese kubuuza abaana omu muringo gwona ogu barikwenda kuhindurwamu, basaba obuhwezi bwabo omu kwambara n’okwambura, kandi babahemu ebironda by’ebyokwambara ebirikubahikaana. Twaba niturora embeera eyo, ahabw’enki ebikorwa ebirikuteekanizibwa ekibiina ky’abegyesa nibihuriire aha kukura kw’okutuura hamwe n’obwenegura?
answer_a: Ahabw’okuba nibakubiriza okuhurirana okuhangamire omu bantu bakuru n’abaana bato, nibareka omwana kwegaita n’obumwe bwabo oburikukurira haihi.
answer_b: Ahabw’okuba nibikiriza omwana kuguumaana n’abakuru kandi bagabaana omu kutwaara obujunaanizibwa buto buto.
answer_c: Ahabw’okuba nibongyera aha bukuru bw’abaana kandi nibabasiisa kwegatta hamwe n’okukoragana n’abakuru.
answer_d: Ahabw’okuba nibikiriza omwana kumanya ngu niweine obushoboorozi bw’okuhurikwa n’okufaho ebirikumwetenga

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omucondo omu mutima gwa Convivencia n'Obwenegura, ateekanisa aha muheru gwa Maaci ekigyendererwa ky'okwega ekirikukurataho: "Okwetaba omu bikorwa by'omukago n'emizano n'abandi, nibagamba, nibahindurangana ebintu, nibakwatanisa." Ni engyenderwaho ki aha zirikukurataho erikukora butunu aha kigyendererwa ekirikugambwaho?
answer_a: Gweeteerane omu gwazoona, oroondemu ebintu kandi otebeekanisize omurimo oguraakorerwe omuri buri mpande.
answer_b: Yetaba omu gw'okuzana "Simon Agambire", orikurikiriza gye ebiragiro by'omusomesa kubaasa kubihikiiriza omu bwire obuhikire.
answer_c: Gamba omuzaano gw'ekibbo ky'obugagga, oroondemu otabulemu ebintu ebirimu obubbo obutali bumwe obuteerwe omu mwanya ogwa hagati omu klasiruumu.
answer_d: Gwekwatagamu omuzaano gw'emigongo y'okubuuza ebibuuzo omu bwire bw'okubuganaho obwa buri izooba (okuramutsya), murikuganiira aha misingye erikushaanisha, murikugondera obwahati bw'okugamba.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa kikaaya kya kindagateni atebeekanize eicumba omu bifo by'okuzanira kandi yongyezaaho ebintu bisya ebirikukwata aha bihurira nk'emeza y'amaizi, omushana, omusenyu, n'embibo. Abaana bakwoleka okushiima kwingi ahabw'okuzanira n'ebintu ebisya; kwonka, hakaba hariho enkaayana omu bweene bwabo obu barikubikoresa. Kurugiirira aha mutindo gw'ebyeshuro gw'abaana, ni engyenderwaho ki aha zirikukora aha kutuura hamwe omu mutindo ogurikwatanisa abaana?
answer_a: Omugyezibwa n'ayingira omuzaano gw'abaana arikukoma omu kubahwera kuruurana ebizibu ebirikubugana nabo n'okubereka omulingo murungi ogw'okukoresa ebintu ebirikukoresibwa.
answer_b: Omugurusi naashaho omwanya gw'okuganiira n'abaana kureeba oku barikukoresa ebintu by'esshomero n'okumaraho obuteeteerwa omu muringo gw'obusingye.
answer_c: Omugyezaho ataho amateeka agumire aha nkoresa y'ebintu ebisya omu mizaano kandi abahumuriza obutoosha kugira ngu bateze omuhanda gw'okutuura hamwe omu mutindo murungi
answer_d: Omugyezihereza aratebeekanisiza omuringo gw'okukyusa omuhanda kuraba omu kutebeekanisiza omutendera omu tubiina tw'emizaano twabazyo kutaahaana n'okukuza obusinge aha bagenzi.

question: Omugurusi w’ekicweka kya Senior Kindergarten yahendize ekigyendererwa ky’okwegyesa ekirikuruga omu mutima gw’okutuura hamwe n’obweneguraasi: "Okumanya ebikorwa ebirungi n’ebibi ahabw’okutuura omu bwengane omu kibiina, ebirikworekwa omu mbeera ez’obutoosha ez’enjura n’emizano". Kandi okuhikiiriza eki, omu bwire bw’okuganiira, bakataho amateeka g’okutuura hamwe kushangwa eby’okugarukamu by’ebizibu ebirikubaho aha beene-mikago. Ni kirikukurataho ki ekirikworeka okuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki kirikugambwaho?
answer_a: Omuhwezi naabuuza ebiragiro omu bwire bw'okubanza, Rafael yaagira ati: "Oshemereire kugyenda omu kicweka ky'eklassi otarikwiruka."
answer_b: Daniela arikurya omu ku by'okurya by'omunywani we omu klasse, yagaruka akarira. Ignacia, arikumwooreka arikurira, yahendera haihi n'omwegyesa yaagira ati: "Munywani wangye arikwetenga obuhwezi."
answer_c: Omu bwire bw'okuzana obwerere, Matías areeba Alejandro orikuzana etraka, bwanyima yaaza haihi, atwaare eky'okuzanisa arikugira ati: "Hati ni nda yange, omwegyesa akagira twine kukigaburirana."
answer_d: Omu bwire bw'okukora omu bibiina, Leonor na Sebastián nibata obuti bw'emibaare nibubuga kuruga omu mwanya gumwe omu kiraasi okugyenda omu gundi. Agustín naizaho yaabagira ati: "Timushemereire kukora ekyo, mushobora kututoma n'emibaare."

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omu klasa ya kindergaten yaacwire kukorera hamwe n'abaana aha bigendererwa ebi birikukurataho kuruga omu Sociocultural Environment Understanding Core: "Kwetegyereza emirimo egi ab'eka n'ab'omukago barikukora n'oku bahwereza aha mbeera nungi ya boona." Ahar'ekigendererwa eki, omwegyesa naateekateeka ngu abaana bashushane eki barikukunda kukora n'eka yaabo reero baganire aha mirimo egi buri omwe omu ka yaabo arikukora omu mbeera eyo. Ku arikworeka omulimo gwe, Martina ayoreka orugyendo rw'eka yaabo kandi agira ati: "Hano nshushaniize obu twagendaga aha nyanja na maama wangye na kokuru, hano ndi kukwataisa na bazukuru bangye boona n'embwa yangye. Tukaryamaga omu hema kandi tukaliire enyama." Omu mirimo egi erikukurataho, n'enki omwegyesa arikukora egi erikuhabura omuishwa omukazi kutunga ekigendererwa ky'okwega eki kirikuteekateekwa?
answer_a: Ekishushani kyaawe nikihikiire munonga, Martina. Webale munonga! Notugambira n'oha orahoire enyama n'oha oteireho eheema?
answer_b: Murungi muno, Martina! Obukenkuru burungi omu kubanzaara ekyo mwena mukora. Bikorwa ki ebi okukunda okukira obundi omu biro by'oruhooro rwaawe?
answer_c: Ekishushani kirungi munonga. Murungi Martina! Noobaasa kutugambira ebintu ebindi birungi mama waawe yaateekire? Okabaasa kumuhwera?
answer_d: Omukubo murungi Martina! Nitubaasa kureeba ab’eka yaawe omu kubooro. Bintu ki ebindi orikukora omu biro by’oruhooro?

question: Mishobo ki erikukuzibwa omu bahara n'abashaija kuraba omu mizaano erikugyenderera amateeka n'enkoragana n'abandi?

answer_b: Okumanya ebiroowozo by'abandi n'okumaraho enkaayana

question: Ni enki aha mbeera ezirikukurataho egi omusingi gw'obwegyese bw'amaani gurikukirayo kwikirizibwa?
answer_a: Ebirikubanza ebirikugarukamu ebi Abana barikukunda kandi bikareeba ebi barikumanya, nibwo birikubahwera kwega.
answer_b: Ebirungo ebirikwemerera omwana kwega okuba, okwega okuteekateeka, n'okwega kukora
answer_c: Ebirungo ebirikuteekateeka emitindo n'omuringo gw'okwega ogurikukwata aha mwana omwe na omwe
answer_d: Ebirungo ebirikukiriza abaana kumanya obushoboorozi bwabo, n'ekibatwara omutima gw'okwesiga obwabo okuhangana n'ebizibu ebisya

question: Ni eki ki ekirikukuriza omwana owa puriskuri kugira embabazi?
answer_a: Kukora omurimo gw'obuhangwa omu babiiri, omwana omwe naatandika okushushana, reero bagihana kuhikiiriza.
answer_b: Mubagambire kubanza kureeba ekintu omu bibiina nibakozesa ebintu by'entaasi, bwanyima mubabuze kubugira ekyabaire kibagumire kukora n'okukigyezaho.
answer_c: Mukore omukaro abaana barikumanyisa nk'ab'eka omu kasheeshe akagarukiremu kandi mubaze oku baraabe beewoise nibabategyereza.
answer_d: Mugambire abaana kworeka omugani "Omunyanzigwa Omweegundiizi," omwana omwe naakwata omugabo gw'omu bantu abarikukorera omu mugani ogwo.
